VSRF Weekly Update with Steve Kirsch
Join Us LIVE!Show more Thursdays 7PM EST
Register: https://www.VacSafety.org
Thursday, December 22, 2022
From Wall Street to Washington, these leaders are revealing the alarming data behind the biggest public health coverup in history.
Ed Dowd, a highly successful Wall Street analyst and former BlackRock portfolio manager, has been working with his partner, expert insurance analyst Josh Stirling, to amass data from the insurance industry, funeral industry & government databases to show an explosion of excess deaths among working aged people starting in 2021. Dowd says he has the smoking-gun evidence to prove mRNA is the culprit and makes his case in the new book, "Cause Unknown" - The Epidemic of Sudden Deaths in 2021 & 2022." Both Ed and Josh recently presented at Sen. Ron Johnson's (R-Wis.) expert roundtable titled, "Covid-19 Vaccines: What They Are, How They Work and Possible Causes of Injuries."
Due to the rescheduling of the Senate vote on the Omnibus Spending Bill, Senator Ron Johnson was unable to join the call. We will record a q&a interview with him and Steve Kirsch to play on a future show.
Purchase Ed Dowd's book here: https://www.amazon.com/Cause-Epidemic-Sudden-Childrens-Defense/dp/1510776397/ref=sr_1_1?crid=3PL5ELEOIM3KQ&keywords=cause+unknown&qid=1671577258&sprefix=cause+unknown%2Caps%2C289&sr=8-1&asin=B0BB8JTNJZ&revisionId=cea932c5&format=1&depth=1
